analysis:
Docs-only change to docs/provider/cli-reference.md: the date bump (line 3) and a rewrite of the `darkbloom sandbox setup` section. Only base text and a truncated patch excerpt were supplied; no head text and no code changes.

Relevant behavior in the patch excerpt:
- Line 1035 changes from "Counts above the estimate are flagged, not refused" to "The plan and the install take a chosen count as it is; setup shows it as `(your choice)`".
- The Check step drops cores, memory and disk from its listing.
- The excerpt cuts off before the rest of the step, so how the eligibility estimate is now presented is not visible.

The base-side setup description in lines 1073-1085 and the add-on command contract in lines 1150-1166 cover TB-013 / T-061. They state that the CLI downloads install.sh over HTTPS only (redirects HTTPS-only, HTTP 200, at most 1 MiB, shebang check, 0600 file in a 0700 directory), does not verify the script beyond TLS, and relies on the add-on installer to verify the release. The changed ranges listed for the head (about 1050-1071, 1087-1096, 1106-1111, 1137-1145, 1164-1172) overlap this section, but I could not see whether any of those verification statements changed. The visible patch does not weaken them.

No threat-model control is shown to be removed or contradicted. The slot-count wording could matter for A-018 (serving availability, T-059), since an operator-chosen slot count is no longer flagged. That is documentation of installer and CLI behavior that is not part of this diff, so I did not treat it as a regression. The next pass should check that the SandboxEligibility / SandboxSetupCommand code matches the new wording. It should also confirm that the doc rewrite did not drop the "CLI does not verify the script beyond TLS" disclosure.
